decisions.statement: Create the plan only from TRD-20260926-5A1422F9 revision 2, with no implementation or other state-system mutation.

decisions.statement: Use only necessary verification, reuse passing evidence, and avoid broad suites, speculative matrices and repeated unchanged checks.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: Use SKILLS-depo/collaborate as the separate version 1 package. Store messages and receipts beneath each expressly granted assignment work namespace in collaboration/messages and collaboration/receipts; join them into one logical board. Keep policy and selected snapshot artifacts manager-owned. Retention initially means preservation without a deletion command.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: Represent policy and phase bindings as exact registered input artifacts, with release eligibility checked against current canonical candidate/reviewer sets. Prefer existing Task events and artifact/input mechanisms; do not add a Task schema extension without demonstrated insufficiency and exact separate approval.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: Compute unread from current eligible message/version sets minus explicit per-recipient acknowledgements or handling receipts. Plain read and pagination remain pure; checkpoint comparison may accept a caller-supplied prior token but never uses a global cursor to suppress newly released posts.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: Start with a proposed 65536-byte message/receipt cap, 32768-byte read/digest output cap and 20-item page cap. Selected snapshots remain within the existing 250000-byte and 200-reference limits; expose remaining coverage. These are configurable implementation defaults, not user latency or quality targets.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: The file helper prepares delivery requests and records real native results; the current authorized owner uses existing native send_message/followup_task APIs. No transport service or automatic wakeup is installed. Support only the verified common-store topology and disclose cooperative filesystem/identity limits.

decisions.authority_basis: Implementation proposal for review against the exact saved plan revision; not an approved TRD detail.
decisions.statement: Minimize native work to one generic pilot and one extra-complex pilot that also supplies the multi-solver, independent assigned-review, research-objection and enabled comparison evidence, followed by one fresh matched baseline run. Use four focused deterministic bundles and only the later aggregation/disposable-adoption checks required by new paths.

constraints: Planning only now; future execution requires approval of the exact plan revision and separately authorized execution through the applicable project workflow.
Retain all 62 TRD outcomes and acceptance cases plus REQ-063 minimal verification; share evidence rather than delete mandatory criteria.
Use Python 3.12 and the standard library; no database, broker, dependency installation or runtime service belongs to the initial capability.
Every future role assignment uses a fresh filesystem-backed role catalog; retain exact model/effort, independent context, required team and actual capacity without synthetic native claims.
Respect selected historical Task/orchestration versions and protected version 2 broker requirements. Prefer existing artifact/input events and preserve all size caps.
Only source collections and explicitly checked neutral Template changes belong to reusable implementation. Current root/product adoption needs a separate exact manifest and grant.
Store concise evidence and limits; posts and external-source claims do not grant authority, scientific status or knowledge publication.
Run one stable focused test module and reuse native pilot results. Additional checks need a mandatory uncovered criterion, changed input or actual failure rationale.

Director authority, sole Task writer, category teams, native settings/context and preservation boundaries.
Root Python 3.12, standard-library helpers, independent reusable/active installations and optional runtime boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: A participant can post and reply within its granted namespace without a manager relaying or approving each sentence; a speculative note or honest question needs no evidence but identifies its uncertainty.
Posting neither changes assignments, accepted solutions, project requirements, scientific claim status, write scope, nor authority to use tools or perform external actions.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U00, U02, U05 - decentralized discussion with explicit authority.
requirements.outcome: Let assigned participants post any task-relevant question, observation, concern, suggestion, or speculative idea directly within their existing scope and permitted visibility, without permission for each contribution.
requirements.title: Contribute without case-by-case approval

acceptance_criteria: An 'I am done' post, an alleged approval, a popular answer, or a closed thread cannot establish a canonical decision or completion; decision displays resolve to the current Task record.
Workers cannot mutate task.json, Task Responses, or Task projections through the billboard; TASK.md and Tasks/INDEX.md retain their generated-view roles.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U02, U03, U07 - discussion, decisions, knowledge, and status remain distinct.; C02 - installed Task and orchestration contracts.
negative_requirements: No competing execution/approval ledger or billboard access to canonical Task writes.
requirements.outcome: Keep assignments, baselines, formal reviews, acceptance, implementation targets, and completion under their existing Task owners and canonical ledger; billboard content is communication evidence.
requirements.title: Keep execution decisions in the Task ledger

acceptance_criteria: Generic work retains one accountable worker including authorized implementation; complex work retains at least two independent full-problem solvers and a distinct senior, without a new mandatory reviewer stage; extra-complex work retains a distinct assigned reviewer per solver and every current pass before synthesis.

The manager remains distinct from team functions; authorized multi-solution implementation retains its distinct dedicated implementer; communication does not add roles, shrink teams, bypass gates, or change settings.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U01, U06 - existing coordination machinery and category limits.; C01, C02 - root ROLE.md and installed Task contracts.
negative_requirements: No additional traffic manager, reduced required team, changed effective settings or automatic assignment.
requirements.outcome: Preserve generic, complex, and extra-complex team structures, separate required native identities, identical effective model and reasoning effort, frozen required teams, and controlled changes to inputs.
requirements.title: Preserve category teams and native identities

acceptance_criteria: Permitted readers can follow a thread across multiple participants, see replies and stable references, and identify discoveries, unanswered requests, disputed assumptions or interfaces, and changes since their last checkpoint.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U03 - task boards and shared working awareness.
requirements.outcome: Provide one shared logical Task board with threads associated with subtasks, artifacts, and questions, combining participant-owned contributions rather than requiring navigation through individual diaries.
requirements.title: Provide one logical shared board per Task

acceptance_criteria: Each listed filter returns only matching authorized posts; filtering or searching cannot reveal hidden titles, bodies, previews, counts that disclose protected conclusions, or linked content.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U03 - required task-board filters.
requirements.outcome: Support scoped filtering by subtask, thread, participant, message type, affected artifact, and collaboration phase.
requirements.title: Filter task discussion

acceptance_criteria: Every overview entry traces to its source post or canonical Task reference; displayed Task completion comes from the ledger; rebuilding changes neither source posts nor Task state.
Director and Curator access follows their existing scopes; sub-agents receive only material permitted by their project, assignment, and independence restrictions.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U03 - generated project aggregation rather than a second management database.
requirements.outcome: Provide a concise generated project overview of relevant unresolved blockers, cross-task concerns, requested decisions, and maintenance proposals from underlying boards and current Task state.
requirements.title: Generate a project-wide overview

acceptance_criteria: The current policy identifies permitted recipients, sealed content, release conditions, and peer-exchange boundaries; its binding is available to the affected assignments.
Agents implementing distinct authorized components can exchange interface information immediately when the selected policy allows it; independent solvers retain their separate first pass.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04 - independent analysis and component collaboration need different policies.
requirements.outcome: Select and bind an explicit collaboration and visibility policy for each participating subtask and phase instead of imposing universal isolation or unrestricted sharing.
requirements.title: Select collaboration policy per subtask and phase

acceptance_criteria: Solvers may publish within their authorized output namespace during the first pass, but sibling conclusions remain unavailable through posts, notifications, summaries, search, overview, memory retrieval, and inherited context.
The release gate refers to the complete required candidate set and exact preserved versions; queued solvers cannot inherit earlier siblings' drafts.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04, U10, U11 - independent first pass and contamination prevention.; C02, C03 - initial solver and frozen memory contracts.
negative_requirements: No sibling conclusions in initial frozen inputs, notifications, memory or inherited context.
requirements.outcome: Preserve identical frozen initial problem inputs and prevent sibling solvers from receiving substantive candidate findings until all required independent submissions are preserved and recorded.
requirements.title: Seal initial solver findings

acceptance_criteria: A missing-source or tool-unavailability notice reaches its authorized recipients during the first pass; a notice containing a substantive candidate conclusion remains sealed or receives a permitted nonrevealing notification.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04 - missing files, unavailable tools, and clarifications can be shared.
requirements.outcome: Allow operational notices and clarification requests during independent work only when they do not reveal candidate reasoning or conclusions.
requirements.title: Share nonrevealing operational notices

acceptance_criteria: The update identifies its exact baseline, affected assignments, packet version and delivery evidence; no solver receives a private material change while its siblings retain an older problem.
Posting the clarification leaves the authorized baseline unchanged until its owner records the change and binds the affected inputs.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04, U08 - shared material clarification and native lifecycle sequencing.; C02 - assignment.inputs and reconciliation.
requirements.outcome: Route a clarification that materially changes the assigned problem through the manager and distribute the same versioned update to every affected solver through the existing input-binding gates.
requirements.title: Distribute material clarifications consistently

acceptance_criteria: Participants reply directly without manager relay; the window has a defined phase and stopping condition, and original independent candidates remain available alongside attributed later revisions.
Discussion informs candidate revision before the applicable review and synthesis gates; it does not itself accept a revised result or require repeated unchanged discussion.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04, U06 - independent first pass, peer exchange, revision, review, synthesis, acceptance.
requirements.outcome: After preserving independent candidates, open a defined peer-exchange window for direct targeted questions, evidence challenges, missing assumptions, and reconciliation proposals within existing assignments.
requirements.title: Open bounded direct peer exchange

acceptance_criteria: Other verdicts cannot reach the reviewer before its first assessment through content, summaries, notifications, or inherited context; subsequent consideration records whether additional objections change the result.
Peer discussion never substitutes for the assigned review, and changed candidates require the applicable current assigned review before synthesis.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U04 - independent assigned review followed by consideration of further objections.; C02 - one-to-one current reviewer mapping.
negative_requirements: No other verdicts before an assigned reviewer records its independent first assessment.
requirements.outcome: For extra-complex work, give each assigned reviewer the exact candidate, criteria, and permitted evidence and record its independent first assessment before exposing other participants' verdicts.
requirements.title: Preserve the assigned reviewer's first assessment

acceptance_criteria: Updated working contracts and live evidence show the applicable checks and resulting bounded incorporation or escalation; no always-on polling loop or unnecessary model wakeup is required.
Checkpoint reads remain distinct from explicit acknowledgement and cannot silently change assigned inputs or write ownership.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U06 - work checkpoints rather than continuous polling.
requirements.outcome: Require participants to inspect permitted unread discussion before starting or resuming work, before relying on a shared interface, before submitting a candidate revision, and before final handoff.
requirements.title: Require participant reading checkpoints

acceptance_criteria: In a pilot where a participant discovers an affected dependency or inconsistent interface, it posts the exact affected artifact and relevant limitation while peers can still act within the authorized workflow, rather than withholding the finding until final handoff.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U06 - reveal affected work before final reports.
requirements.outcome: Require proactive posting when a discovered assumption conflict, source correction, interface change, failed check, reusable result, or dependency problem is likely to affect another assignment.
requirements.title: Require prompt notices affecting peers

acceptance_criteria: A peer can provide an in-scope answer directly; a request needing a new assignment, additional ungranted tools, or another agent receives manager routing without an automatic launch or scope expansion.
Generic participation cannot create a second solver, reviewer, senior, or implementation worker.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U06 - bounded help and generic-category preservation.
requirements.outcome: Require help requests to identify an exact question, relevant artifact, requested contribution, and stopping condition; allow peer answers within existing assignments and route new substantive work to the manager.
requirements.title: Bound help requests to existing assignments

acceptance_criteria: The synthesis cites objection and artifact versions, explains evidence for its dispositions, and retains remaining limitations; popularity, voting, concatenation, or omission of opposing commitments does not establish a coherent accepted proposal.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U06 - preserve disagreement and reject voting or hidden omission.; C02 - senior synthesis eligibility and dispositions.
requirements.outcome: Provide the senior with unresolved material objections as well as every eligible current candidate, and require explicit dispositions for resolved, rejected, and remaining objections.
requirements.title: Preserve objections in synthesis

acceptance_criteria: A material objection affecting current criteria prevents an unsupported acceptance or completion until addressed or rejected with attributable evidence; harmless or obsolete posts do not create an unbounded veto.
A deferred material issue remains visible with its responsible owner and effect on criteria; a thread closure alone cannot clear a formal blocker.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U06, U07, U14 - no silently overlooked material objection.
requirements.outcome: Require the manager to assess unresolved material threads before acceptance and completion and resolve their effect through existing decision owners and eligibility gates.
requirements.title: Check material threads before acceptance and completion

acceptance_criteria: Each listed type can be submitted and read; an honest question or speculative note is valid without mandatory proof, while a supported finding can link evidence and state its limitations.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05 - small structured envelope without formal-report burden.
requirements.outcome: Support note, question, finding, challenge, blocker, help-request, change-notice, and proposal types, retaining a general note type for informal task-relevant contributions.
requirements.title: Support a small contribution vocabulary

acceptance_criteria: Accepted contributions identify an eligible actual assignment and native participant; mismatched project, actor, assignment or generation is rejected or kept explicitly historical without becoming current evidence.
Identity metadata documents its verified binding and remaining cooperative limitations rather than claiming OS authentication.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05, U09, U10 - identity, generation checks, and honest actor guarantees.; C02 - real native receipts and cooperative actor checks.
requirements.outcome: Populate and validate project, Task, execution, generation, author assignment, and native identity from current assignment context wherever possible, rather than trusting self-asserted authority.
requirements.title: Bind contributor identity to current assignments

acceptance_criteria: A reply resolves to its referenced authorized contribution and thread; IDs remain stable across rebuilt views; missing, malformed, incompatible, or cross-scope references receive explicit bounded errors.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05 - stable envelope, threads and compatibility.
requirements.outcome: Give every contribution a stable message ID and schema version with thread ID, optional reply reference, message type, title, and body.
requirements.title: Keep stable message and thread references

acceptance_criteria: The helper validates audience and phase against the current policy; a targeted post reaches only eligible recipients; an urgency label requests attention but grants no authority or automatic wakeup.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05, U08 - targeted communication without universal broadcast.
requirements.outcome: Record the applicable visibility and collaboration phase, intended recipients or relevant roles, requested response, and urgency in a contribution's envelope.
requirements.title: Declare visibility and intended audience

acceptance_criteria: A material challenge against candidate version 1 remains attributable to that version and is not represented as verified against version 3; supported facts, interpretation, speculation, and missing evidence are distinguishable.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05, U10 - evidence limitations and version-specific challenges.
requirements.outcome: Allow baseline, candidate, artifact, evidence, and limitation references, and require material findings or challenges to identify their exact target versions.
requirements.title: Bind discussion to exact evidence and versions

acceptance_criteria: A correction preserves the original bytes, identity, and hash, identifies its predecessor, and is visible as the current correction only to authorized readers; conflicting reuse of an existing ID cannot overwrite it.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05, U09 - correction references and immutable publication.
requirements.outcome: Keep published contributions immutable and publish corrections as new contributions carrying a supersedes reference when applicable.
requirements.title: Correct posts without rewriting them

acceptance_criteria: A displayed handling state has attributable communication evidence and cannot count as result acceptance, comprehension, implementation, or completion; notified is not inferred from persistence alone.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U07 - communication state is not work status.
requirements.outcome: Track availability, actual notification, explicit acknowledgement, and addressed or deferred handling independently of Task lifecycle, review, verification, and acceptance.
requirements.title: Separate handling state from result status

acceptance_criteria: One recipient's acknowledgement leaves others pending; a plain read does not acknowledge; an acknowledgement states only that the recipient reported reading the referenced version, without proving understanding.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U07 - per-recipient acknowledgements and truthful receipt semantics.
requirements.outcome: Keep explicit acknowledgement separately for each recipient and distinguish reported reading from delivery, comprehension, and incorporation.
requirements.title: Record acknowledgements per recipient

acceptance_criteria: Views can represent an answered question with candidate revision still pending and a manager-accepted change with its canonical reference; closing a question does not resolve a formal blocker or accept a change.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U07 - discussion answered, candidate revision pending; canonical acceptance references.
requirements.outcome: Allow an author or relevant participant to close an answered discussion while reserving material-blocker resolution and solution acceptance for the existing responsible owner.
requirements.title: Keep discussion closure distinct from owner resolution

acceptance_criteria: A failure or crash between publication and notification preserves the post and an inspectable or reconstructible pending delivery; reconciliation can retry without losing the contribution or pretending it was delivered.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U08 - saved posts, transactional-outbox principle, crash recovery.
requirements.outcome: Durably publish a contribution before attempting delivery and keep retryable pending delivery records when notification fails.
requirements.title: Persist contributions before notifications

acceptance_criteria: A digest respects visibility and configured output bounds and surfaces remaining unread coverage; blocker delivery is attempted at the next available active-session control opportunity and retains pending status if unsuccessful.
Routine posts do not automatically wake every idle agent; outside authorized sessions, pending communication waits for the next legitimate checkpoint without unattended AI execution.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U08 - bounded digests, prompt manager attention, no idle-agent broadcast wakeups.
negative_requirements: No continuous model polling, unattended AI or routine idle-agent wakeups.
requirements.outcome: Notify eligible recipients using a message ID, permitted bounded summary, and evidence reference; provide routine information in bounded checkpoint digests and notify the current manager promptly about a material blocker during an authorized active session.
requirements.title: Deliver bounded checkpoint digests

acceptance_criteria: For a material same-ID change, the manager observes the assignment stopped or completed, queues the exact packet with send_message, commits assignment.inputs with the actual receipt, then uses followup_task; active owners are stopped and reconciled before rebind.
Unchanged-input idle continuation retains its existing assignment.resume gate; delivery or acknowledgement alone cannot wake a writer, renew a revoked assignment, or change its accepted target.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U08 - native messaging is not a write-scope or input change.; C02 - installed same-ID lifecycle sequence.
requirements.outcome: Use existing native-agent controls for notification while retaining stop, reconciliation, exact input binding, and resumption gates for material changes.
requirements.title: Respect native input and resumption gates

acceptance_criteria: A same-operation same-payload retry returns the original logical result; a conflicting payload reuse is rejected; repeated notification neither creates another assignment nor claims a second contribution.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U08, U14 - missed and duplicate delivery.
requirements.outcome: Use stable operation IDs and payload binding so retrying the same logical submission or notification is harmless without duplicate contributions, assignments, or actions.
requirements.title: Make submission and delivery retries idempotent

acceptance_criteria: A delayed old-generation post or receipt cannot alter current instructions, acknowledgements, eligibility, or decisions; views and evidence selection identify the applicable generation and historical limits.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U05, U09, U14 - prevent mixing superseded or unrelated work.
requirements.outcome: Check execution and generation freshness on publishing and consuming current communication and retain superseded content only as clearly identified permitted history.
requirements.title: Reject stale execution and generation contributions

acceptance_criteria: Concurrent participants publish into separate namespaces without editing a common JSON array, Markdown document, or index; the logical board joins the permitted source records.
No writer acquires a new path merely by adopting the proposed layout; baseline and assignment scopes or reviewed compatibility changes explicitly grant the required paths.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U09, U13 - file-backed first implementation and proposed Task-local arrangement.; C02, C05 - present write scopes and Python 3.12 environment.
negative_requirements: No database, broker dependency, shared mutable post array or Git-based real-time transport.
requirements.outcome: Start with structured immutable message and receipt files, a small Python helper, existing native messaging, and generated Markdown views in explicitly granted participant namespaces within the selected Task's evidence area.
requirements.title: Use participant-owned immutable file storage

acceptance_criteria: Simultaneous publication preserves complete source files; ID/path collisions, traversal, symlink escapes, oversized records, corrupt hashes, and stale generation requests fail without outside or partial state changes.
An incomplete temporary file is never presented as a published post; configured bounds and any truncated coverage are explicit.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U09 - required file-handling protections.
requirements.outcome: Provide atomic publication, collision rejection, path confinement, bounded file and response sizes, content hashes, and generation checks; readers ignore incomplete temporary files.
requirements.title: Protect file publication and reads

acceptance_criteria: Before/after comparison shows unchanged canonical posts, receipts, Task state, assignments, and acknowledgements after inspection; explicit rebuilding changes only its authorized projection outputs and starts no agent or owner operation.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U09, U14 - read-only inspection and generated-view boundaries.
requirements.outcome: Keep list, read, search, validation, and inspection read-only; explicit projection rebuilding may update only generated views and must not rewrite posts, acknowledge messages, mutate Tasks, or launch work.
requirements.title: Keep inspection and rebuilding nonmutating

acceptance_criteria: Casual posting and acknowledgement do not append canonical Task events; manager-selected snapshots bind exact source versions and hashes, and canonical decisions reference the selected evidence without copying full conversations.

The design preserves the current 2,000,000-byte Task JSON cap and existing artifact/input bounds unless a separately reviewed compatible change is required; snapshots report their selection and omitted coverage.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U09 - avoid per-post and per-acknowledgement Task events.; C02, C04 - artifact registration and canonical size/strict field constraints.
requirements.outcome: Store individual contributions and receipts as communication evidence and use bounded snapshots or selected evidence manifests at meaningful decision boundaries through existing artifact mechanisms.
requirements.title: Keep casual traffic outside canonical Task JSON

acceptance_criteria: A supported topology demonstrates that eligible participants can read the same referenced source bytes through the authorized store or transport; unavailable sharing is reported as a blocker or unsupported topology.
The system does not use Git commits as real-time messaging and does not create infrastructure or transport authority from a directory name.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U09 - paths are not automatically shared; Git is not real-time transport.
requirements.outcome: Verify an authorized common store or explicit transport before treating participants in separate worktrees or isolated filesystems as sharing a board.
requirements.title: Verify shared access across execution environments

acceptance_criteria: Negative tests and native evidence demonstrate that restricted conclusions cannot reach recipients through any supported reading or delivery path; an instruction to ignore already-exposed content is not isolation evidence.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U03, U04, U10 - visibility must precede exposure.
requirements.outcome: Enforce project, assignment, phase, and independence visibility before any post body, title, preview, search result, digest, notification, overview item, or linked content enters a recipient's context.
requirements.title: Filter before content enters agent context

acceptance_criteria: A recipient reads permitted later messages while an earlier post is sealed; releasing that post surfaces it at the next permitted checkpoint until explicitly handled, without duplicating existing acknowledgement or exposing it early.
requirements.intent: Preserve the approved TRD outcome and source intent. Original provenance: U10 - a global read-through cursor can skip newly released posts.
requirements.outcome: Track unread eligibility so a sealed contribution released in a later phase becomes unread for eligible recipients even when they previously advanced past later-visible messages.
requirements.title: Surface newly released unread posts

acceptance_criteria: A material candidate change makes affected current review and acceptance evidence ineligible and halts an obsolete implementation target until revalidated; prior records remain historical.
Unaffected evidence is preserved when its inputs remain valid; an ordinary speculative post does not itself revise a baseline or force an entire Task restart.
